title: HOW TO USE ASTRA WITH UNITY
author: sakul243
selftext:
I am currently tring to change my art with astra.  
I am using unity MCP and told astra it should make me my 2d charakter whiched used all my tokens for 5h with 20$ plan.  
Need help to use less token pls

comments.author: IAmhowlshot
comments.body:
Start new session with atra High
Give it the files of your 2d character and ask it to create a comprehensive plan to get it into unity,animated, etc, and to use unity CLI and blender mcpnif necessary 

Take the plan and give it to 5.6 Sol to execute

See if that helps

comments.author: CycleMother2006
comments.body:
How did you, exactly, tell it to make you this 2d character? Was it using a program like Aseprite? Procedural shapes in game? SVGs? imagegenning sprites? No direction at all?

Because the direction matters a lot. And without clear, concise instructions I can't begin to guess what it was trying to do for you. Like what does 'make me a character' even mean? What was the success case? Was it a single image? Or a character with 7 directional movement, idle and attack animations, a jump / falling / land animation set, etc? What was the resolution of the character? Small pixel art creations via aseprite wouldn't take much in the way of tokens, but if you up that resolution to something like 256x256, suddenly you're multiplying the work by roughly 300x what it would take for a 16x16.
